name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food Truck ordering app
promotionalText: Take orders ahead, protect the kitchen from orders beyond its capacity and keep selling even when you lose signal. The ordering app for Food Truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for Food Trucks: the tool your team uses in every trading session.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark the order “Ready” and “Collected”.

■ Don’t promise a time you can’t make
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it needs. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose that time, so the waiting queue matches the kitchen’s pace.

■ Take orders in person at the Food Truck
Add walk-up orders on the same screen as the orders placed ahead, so the kitchen works from one queue.

■ One screen for the kitchen
The kitchen screen (KDS) shows what to make now, what to make next and what is ready, and gives a notification when an order needs starting.

■ Print order tickets
Connect a kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or over your local network, and order tickets print automatically.

■ Keep selling even when you lose signal
Switch on offline protection and, if the connection drops, orders ahead pause for now so nobody places an order you can’t see. Orders you take on the device are saved and sync when you have internet again.

■ Built for the Food Truck van
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during the trading session, get a notification when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

■ Plan the week
Set your events and places once and take orders for each event.

HatchGrab is for Food Truck owners and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to log in.
